name: 烏燕鷗
illustrationTaxon: Adult sooty tern, sex unspecified; blackish upperparts and crown, white forehead ending before eye, white underparts, black bill and dark legs. Main art reused from 0203 sooty tern comparison.

sources.use: Substantive read: 36–45 cm, HK mostly first-year; adult dark uniform upperparts, white forehead not extending beyond eye; HK accidental associated with tropical storms, records 5 April–20 October; pantropical ocean, LC, global trend unknown.
